format_hint:
Answer with exactly two short noun phrases, one per line, nothing else. Each phrase must end with the word 'nuclei' and combine shape, colour and size, in the form:
<size> <shape> <colour> nuclei
<size> <shape> <colour> nuclei

They range from small, about 5-10 micrometers in diameter, to larger, occasionally up to 20 micrometers, especially in goblet cells or in areas of inflammation where there might be cell hypertrophy. The nuclei tend to have a relatively uniform appearance with visible nucleoli in some cases, appearing as small, dense, darker regions within the nuclear stain.
